name: Helpful Wisp Swarm OLD
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-13: Thick as Thieves

stealth.note: (trained) to notice the creatures hovering in the trees

description: Hovering amid the branches of an acacia tree, a swarm of wood wisps attempt to gather the papers that have been caught in its leaves and thorns.
disable: Diplomacy DC 21 Diplomacy (trained) to make a Request, DC 21 Athletics (trained) to climb the tree and help gather papers manually, or DC 23 Performance (trained) to demonstrate how the wisps can help without destroying the papers.
routine: (3 actions) The wisp swarm loses one action for each successful check to disable it. The wisps swarm to work on each of their actions, making a headbutt Strike against any creature within 10 feet of the tree and destroying 2d4 #pages pages of notes.

offensiveAbilities.name: Willing Wisps
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature comes within 10 feet of the tree or directly addresses the wood wisps

Effect The wood wisp swarm animatedly tries to help the group gather the papers, destroying 2d4 #pages pages, and then rolls initiative.
